description: This Java class demonstrates the usage of SearchView in an Android ActionBar, managing search suggestions, query submission, and UI updates based on user interactions.

classes.name: SearchViewActionBar
classes.description: An activity that uses a SearchView in the ActionBar to perform searches and display query status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and prepares the SearchView and status TextView.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu resource, finds the SearchView menu item, and sets up the SearchView.

methods.name: setupSearchView
methods.description: Configures the SearchView with searchable info and behavior based on whether it should always be expanded.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Updates the status TextView with the current query text during typing.

methods.name: onQueryTextSubmit
methods.description: Displays the submitted query in the status TextView.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Handles the closure of the SearchView and updates the status TextView.

methods.name: isAlwaysExpanded
methods.description: Determines if the SearchView should always be expanded (returns false by default).
